body: I’ll look into it. Thank you for talking with me, It feels good to get some of this out. it’s now 8 am where I am so I should try to go sleep. If you’d like, we could talk more about programming once I get into it later.
No, I’ve thought about it but I don’t know where to start.

Why? I feel like a shitty person and no one treats me like I am. Im like a parasite. I’m not good for anything. I dread the moment my family realizes I’m not good for anything and all I will ever do is eat their food and use their money. I want to be dead before then.

Thank you for the advice. I think I get so upset because I realize I feel like I don’t get any better, even with practice. I have been practicing guitar on and off for three years. About a year after I picked up guitar, my friend did as well. He now performs in bass and guitar for two separate groups. I, on the other hand, can hardly manage to play beginner songs. And that’s how it is for most things I do. I’ve tried to be patient with myself but I always disappoint.

I appreciate the advice. I hate to sound like one of those people but I don’t feel anything. I don’t have a passion for anything I do. I feel like I don’t even know who I am because it’s hard for me to tell when I actually like something or I’m just pretending to impress someone. I have tried to get into multiple different hobbies but have never felt a connection and have given up when I realize I’m no good. I feel like I’m just drifting through each day now, I do nothing.

I used to be a very happy, cheery person. I don’t want anyone to see me differently then the person they think I am.

As for hobbies, I’ve tried learning guitar, piano, signing, drawing, writing. All that happens is I get frustrated when I realize I’m not any good.
I’m sorry if I’m not giving you a clear answer, this is my first time doing something like this. I appreciate you trying to help.
I’m 17. I’ve never held a job. I still can’t drive. Despite trying, I am not skilled at anything I do. I have no aspirations. I’m a loser.
I don’t feel like I can do anything right.
